Hi Marcus,

We're showing invoice INV-7890 (due 2028-07-10) as outstanding for 24 days. Total outstanding: EUR 67,420. I know you've been a strong partner; I wanted to propose a pragmatic path to close this quickly without escalating collections.

Proposed staged remit:

- Remaining 70% (EUR 47,194) by Tuesday 2028-08-15

2) VAT reverse-charge evidence or local tax documentation so we can clear VAT on our side (attach VAT docs if available).
